# SeaWorld

> SeaWorld operates three major theme parks with integrated zoos and aquariums dedicated to animal experiences, conservation education, and wildlife learning.

SeaWorld combines entertainment with educational missions across its Orlando, San Diego, and San Antonio locations. The site provides extensive educational resources on marine mammals, wildlife conservation, and animal science for teachers and families.

## Key Topics

- Marine mammals
- Conservation
- Animal education
- Theme parks
- Wildlife experiences
- Teacher resources
- Classroom activities
- Dolphins
- Whales
- Sharks
- Pinnipeds
- Penguins
- Polar bears
- SeaWorld Orlando
- SeaWorld San Diego

## Theme Parks & Attractions

- [SeaWorld: Visit with Purpose](https://seaworld.com): SeaWorld homepage featuring theme parks in Orlando, San Diego, San Antonio with animal experiences and conservation.
- [SeaWorld Orlando](https://seaworld.com/orlando): SeaWorld Orlando park overview with rides, animal encounters, events, and ticket information.
- [SeaWorld San Antonio](https://seaworld.com/san-antonio): SeaWorld San Antonio park featuring attractions, rides, animal experiences, and vacation packages.
- [SeaWorld San Diego](https://seaworld.com/san-diego): SeaWorld San Diego theme park with rides, animal encounters, events, and visitor planning resources.

## Educational Resources

- [Educational Resources Hub](https://seaworld.com/educational-resources): Educational hub with free resources, videos, activities for learning about marine animals and wildlife.
- [Sharks Educational Guide](https://seaworld.com/educational-resources/sharks): Educational guide on sharks covering species profiles, facts, and conservation information.
- [Whales Educational Resource](https://seaworld.com/educational-resources/whales): Educational resource on whales including species classification, facts, and classroom materials.
- [Pinnipeds Educational Content](https://seaworld.com/educational-resources/pinnipeds): Educational content on pinnipeds (seals, sea lions, walruses) with facts and teacher guides.
- [Penguins Educational Content](https://seaworld.com/educational-resources/penguins): Penguin educational resource with species information, videos, and K-8 classroom activities.
- [Polar Bears Educational Guide](https://seaworld.com/educational-resources/polar-bears): Educational guide on polar bears covering Arctic habitat, adaptations, and conservation topics.
